name: whisper.cpp Server
description: Transcribes audio locally through a resident whisper.cpp server, so the model stays loaded between voice messages.

baseUrl.description: Loopback URL of the running whisper.cpp server. Only localhost, 127.0.0.0/8 and ::1 are accepted.

model.description: Label reported as the transcription model, for example ggml-base.en. The server decides which model actually runs.

maxQueuedRequests.description: Requests that may wait while one is transcribing. The server handles one request at a time; further requests are refused.
